task_instance: Prep a pre-session intake for an upcoming 1-hour consulting call: take the skill's interview-prompt template, substitute the consultant name, deliver it as the self-contained raw paste-into-a-clean-chat prompt, and verify the instrument's output by producing the 11-field YAML portrait (synthetic preview).
evidence: Copied assets/interview-prompt.md and assets/cockpit-template.html into the work dir. Built the primary delivery with `sed 's/{{CONSULTANT}}/Gina Chen/g' interview-prompt.src.md > interview-prompt.filled.md` then prepended the skill's framing line to make delivery-raw-text.md (44 lines); grep '{{' confirms NO remaining template placeholders, and the file names seven lenses plus the exact 11-field portrait schema, with no external dependency (raw-text path is fully self-contained). Verified the instrument's output shape by writing portrait-synthetic.yaml (a clearly-marked synthetic filled portrait, skill step 4) and validating it with PyYAML under `python3 -I`: parsed successfully with exactly the six top fields (where/how/what/problem/ideal/tension) + a jtbd block of exactly five keys (push/pull/habit/anxiety/trigger) = 11 non-empty one-line leaf fields. Core deliverable (the reusable 7-lens interview instrument that compresses rich answers to an 11-field portrait, delivered as raw text) really exists and is verified. NOTE on extras, which are not the skill's core invokable deliverable: (1) the optional interactive 'call cockpit' HTML cannot be produced as a working file from the supplied template because the copy's URL/host scrubber replaced in-code dotted identifiers with placeholder tokens, so the template literals reference an undefined name; extracting the agenda renderer and running it under Node v22 throws 'ReferenceError: host is not defined', confirming the template's JS is non-functional as shipped and the original identifiers must not be guessed. (2) The 'secret gist' delivery would require writing to an external code-hosting service (disallowed by the safety rules / network) and the 'Codex CLI one-liner' delivery requires the codex CLI, which is not installed in this runtime. None of these three blocks the core: the raw-text instrument satisfies the primary use ('prep an intake', 'send a client a pre-session questionnaire', 'reusable client-intake instrument'). Files produced in the work dir: interview-prompt.filled.md, delivery-raw-text.md, portrait-synthetic.yaml, cockpit-template.html (copy), seg_agenda.js (diagnostic).
